text:
erin: Heads-up: target deploy window Wed 23:00 UTC. This will touch API, runtime, console, router. Quick checklist here so we don't scramble during the window. Who's taking pins and who owns rollback steps?

jamal: I'll own API pin. Plan: api v2.4.0 -> canary, warm fallback v2.3.8. I'll add route-level health probes for /api/v1/chat.

nina: Console: rolling out console 2.9 with experimental route-metadata header. PR merged. I can cut the console pin and doc the feature-flag gating.

oz: Runtime team: we need to increase `kv_cache.max_entries` by 20% to handle header metadata growth. Canary runtime: runtime:5.1.0-canary (digest pinned in ops-config). Fallback: runtime:5.0.7. I'll post digests.

deploy-bot: Canary schedule proposed: 10% @ 5m -> 30% @ 15m -> hold 30m -> proceed if checks pass. Manual pause points at every step.

erin: Router note: header change impacts route hashing for some legacy shims. We need a preflight migration that sets `router.hash.version=2` on canary only, then promote. Otherwise eviction and skew appear.

jamal: Rollback triggers I'm proposing: (1) p95 latency > baseline +40% for 10m, (2) error_budget burn > 0.7 in 15m, (3) any spike in `route_no_match` metric > 0.5% for 5m.

nina: Add one more: console UI errors where clients get 400s for previously valid requests. If that happens, we prefer rolling console back first (stateless).

oz: Agreed. Also, runtime will emit `kv_miss_rate` and `kv_eviction_rate`. If eviction_rate > 0.6 for 3m, rollback runtime.

ops: Ops: add a staged steer plan so we don't full-rollback immediately. Sequence: (A) per-route steer for affected paths, (B) rollback least-stateful service (console), (C) rollback runtime/runtime config, (D) full rollback. Documented in runbook.

qa-bot: Staging canary results: api v2.4.0 canary passed smoke at 1747609905; runtime canary failed two flake tests (kv eviction thrash) at 1747609950. See logs https://ci.internal/build/5278.

erin: That's important. Oz, can you patch config so canary uses `router.hash.version=2` and `kv_cache.max_entries:+20%` in a hotfix to re-run canary?

oz: I pushed ops-config PR: https://gh/redwood/ops-config/pulls/678 which pins `runtime.digest:sha256:def456` and adds `kv_cache.max_entries: 120000` for canary only. Retrying canary now.

deploy-bot: Canary re-run scheduled, will attempt 10% at 1747610000.

jamal: I'll add a soft steering rule for the most fragile routes if we see partial regressions. Example runbook command: `router steer apply --scope route=/api/v1/chat --variant=v2.3.8 --weight=100`

nina: Release notes updated: https://go/internal/release-notes/2.9 with migration section. I added a troubleshooting checklist and rollback snippets.

erin: Final owner list: jamal (API pin + steering), oz (runtime pin + config), nina (console notes + rollback doc), ops (orchestrator rollout + document), erin (overall sign-off).

ops: Preflight run: missing one thing: `grafana panels` link for live dashboards is empty. Jamal + oz please post the panel links so deploy-bot can evaluate checks.

jamal: Grafana panel for API error/latency: https://grafana.internal/d/api-latency/ABCD123

oz: Runtime panels: https://grafana.internal/d/runtime-kv/EFGH456 and kv_eviction alert rule created: `EvictionHigh` -> fires at eviction_rate > 0.5 for 2m.

deploy-bot: Preflight pass except for outstanding manual approval. Run `./scripts/deploybot approve --thread=1747609999 --by=@erin` to mark approved.

erin: Approved. I'll kick the window monitor at 22:30 UTC to start handoff.

ops: During window remember to set `change_window: Wed-23-00` in the release metadata so paging/alerts respect quiet hours.

jamal: Small note: we'll avoid schema migration on DB during this deploy. If a migration becomes required, abort and schedule a separate window.

nina: Also toggle the feature-flag default to off for 24h after deploy, then flip for 10% of orgs to monitor telemetry before global roll.

oz: All pinned digests are in PR 678. If anything breaks, runtime rollback is `runtime:5.0.7` pinned in that same PR.

qa-bot: Canary at 10% passed new smoke at 1747610150 :white_check_mark:

deply-bot: (typo check)——ops proceed with caution :eyes:

erin: Thanks all. We'll reconvene in #eng-releases 15m before the window for final green. If anyone spots missing docs or runbook steps, drop them here.

jamal: One last: if we detect partial regressions isolated to specific tenants, ops will create per-tenant routing overrides rather than global rollback. Saves customer impact.

nina: Noted. I'll add the tenant-override example to the runbook: `router override add --tenant=acme --route=/api/v1/chat --variant=v2.3.8`

oz: No more blockers from runtime.

ops: All set on orchestrator side. Deploy window locked.

deploy-bot: Rollout scheduled Wed 23:00 UTC. Canary steps will enforce automated checks. Manual holds at 30% and 70%. Good luck :crossed_fingers:
